model: M1 carry seed 22 raw main step 2,000

source.spatial_sampling: WB2 latitude[::4], longitude[::4] matching the native training grid

climatology_metadata.window: circular ±30 calendar days inclusive within a 365-day calendar; February 29 excluded from reference samples
climatology_metadata.day_index: January 1 is index 0; array order [calendar_day, utc_hour, latitude, longitude]
climatology_metadata.quantile_method: linear empirical quantile interpolation over order statistics; float64 interpolation, float32 storage
climatology_metadata.tp24: four consecutive WB2 TP6 fields ending at valid UTC, summed in float64 and converted from metres to mm
climatology_metadata.rain_eligibility: tp24_q95 > 1 mm at each calendar day, UTC hour and grid point
climatology_metadata.land_mask_rule: land_mask >= 0.5 on the native evaluation grid

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks of 5 starts at a 3-day cadence

scorer_provenance: Local implementation of the A2 handoff. Original frozen observer and scorer unavailable.
weighting: exact spherical grid-cell area including polar caps
tail: forecast minus truth on truth-event cells, in K, m/s or mm
